items.title: Nvidia in Talks to Finance OpenAI, Report Says. What It Means for the Stock.
items.summary: Chip stocks fell sharply in morning trading after a report emerged that a state-backed Chinese company has started mass producing chip-making machines.  Nvidia has missed out on the chip rally this year, up just 11% compared with the  (SOX) 67% rise — the index that tracks the 30 biggest U.S.-listed companies connected to semi’s. That’s started to change recently, though—the stock is up 3% in July through Friday, while the SOX was down 17%.  OpenAI and Nvidia did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
